core: Cerebellar cortex formation and motor coordination
qualifier: cerebellar granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glial layering
name: Cerebellar cortex layering and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar layer formation (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia) with locomotion, proprioception, motor learning and reflexes, unlike confusables centred on brainstem/hindbrain maturation, glycinergic transmission or forebrain development.

qualifier: kinetochore attachment, spindle checkpoint and midzone elongation
name: Mitotic spindle kinetochore attachment, checkpoint and midzone elongation
rationale: All members concern mitotic spindle assembly and kinetochore-microtubule attachment with checkpoint control; spindle midzone assembly and elongation separate it from confusables focused on AURKA/PLK1 mitotic entry, sister chromatid cohesion or cytokinesis.

name: Surface receptor internalization toward lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members promote receptor endocytosis, lysosomal targeting and catabolism while limiting recycling and surface localization, whereas confusables are dominated by cholesterol homeostasis, SREBP and LDL/HDL handling.

name: Glomerular mesangial and endothelial development
rationale: All members concern development of the glomerular mesangium and glomerular vasculature, unlike confusables about metanephric mesenchyme, tubule formation and kidney growth control.

qualifier: CYP oxidation and acetyl, methyl and sulfo conjugation of aromatic compounds
name: Xenobiotic oxidation and conjugation of aromatic compounds
rationale: Members cover phase I CYP oxidation (CYP2E1, CYP1A2, demethylation) and phase II acetylation, methylation and sulfonation of aromatic, alkaloid and nitrogenous compounds such as paracetamol, whereas confusables add FMO oxidation, thiopurine methylation and steroid metabolism.

name: Regulation of macrophage cytokine and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members regulate cytokine output (macrophage cytokines, TGF-beta1, TNF/IL-23/IL-6-family effectors, IL-37 and autocrine signalling), distinguishing them from confusables centred on IL-10/IL-27 family receptor signalling, IL-6-type receptor signalling or myeloid NF-kB activation.

name: MicroRNA silencing through deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and silencing by poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly, unlike confusables about miRNA turnover, siRNA processing or translational repression of specific targets.

Members mix promoter-motif gene sets, ER compartment and ER-membrane insertion sets, an extracellular-region set and unrelated responses to heparin, glycoprotein and endothelial-matrix adhesion, with no single biological process shared by all.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, hindbrain and limbs
name: Hox-driven axial patterning of somites, hindbrain and limbs
rationale: Members cover Hox clusters, somitogenesis, rhombomere and neural plate patterning and limb/joint morphogenesis, distinguishing the theme from confusables about craniofacial and pharyngeal organ development or axial mesoderm and ventral neural tube patterning.

qualifier: enhanced glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission in locomotion and sensorimotor gating
name: Synaptic transmission enhancement underlying locomotion and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members pair positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission with locomotor, exploratory and prepulse-inhibition behavior, unlike confusables about spine maintenance, AMPA receptor clustering, neurotrophic signalling or grooming/amygdala.

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members centre on netrin-activated attraction/repulsion, axon extension control and collateral sprouting of monoaminergic and sensory axons, distinguishing them from confusables built on ephrin/L1, SLIT-ROBO or Sema3A signalling.

name: Cardiac muscle hypertrophic adaptation, regeneration and survival
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization, stress hypertrophy, regeneration and anti-apoptosis, unlike confusables about contractility, cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation or calcineurin-NFAT cell-size signalling.

qualifier: replicase translation, genome replication and mRNA capping
name: SARS coronavirus replicase, genome replication and mRNA capping
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV-1/2 replicase translation and maturation, genome replication, cap formation for IFIT evasion and host translation modulation, unlike confusables dominated by influenza and RSV replication or frameshifting.

qualifier: omega-hydroxylation, epoxidation and leukotriene B4 inactivation
name: Cytochrome P450 eicosanoid omega-hydroxylation, epoxidation and leukotriene inactivation
rationale: Members cover P450 omega-hydroxylase (HETE) and epoxygenase (EET/DHET) branches plus omega-oxidative leukotriene B4 catabolism, distinguishing them from confusables about leukotriene synthesis, lipoxygenase/hepoxilin or cyclooxygenase/prostanoid pathways.

name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and co-transcriptional capping
rationale: Members cover pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape, early elongation complex formation and CTD phosphorylation-coupled capping (including HIV), while confusables concern productive elongation, pausing and Tat-dependent HIV elongation.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and ESCRT-III-mediated reassembly
rationale: Members cover lamina depolymerization, nuclear membrane breakdown, reformation and ESCRT-III sealing with midbody abscission, unlike confusables about contractile ring cytokinesis, chromosome condensation or SUMOylation.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and growth restraint
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and dedifferentiation with negative regulation of proliferation, migration and differentiation, distinguishing it from confusables with positive proliferation/migration or endothelial activation.

name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and surfactant dysfunction disorders
rationale: All members concern surfactant metabolism and homeostasis or defects in surfactant proteins, ABCA3 and GM-CSF receptors, unlike confusables about lung epithelial differentiation, erythrocyte gas transport or phospholipid scrambling.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, oxidative phosphorylation, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, ROS output and PGC-1alpha with linked depolarization and apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on peroxide-induced cell death and ferroptosis.

qualifier: influenza vRNP nuclear trafficking and RSV replication
name: RNA virus replication including influenza vRNP nuclear trafficking
rationale: Members span influenza, RSV and SARS-CoV genome transcription, replication, translation and host-defence evasion, with influenza vRNP nuclear import/export and RSV replication distinguishing it from confusables limited to coronavirus or HIV/HCMV processes.

name: Dendritic spine maintenance and amyloid-beta synaptic impairment
rationale: Members regulate spine and neuron projection maintenance and postsynaptic organization alongside amyloid-beta response and LTP inhibition, unlike confusables centred on Reelin signalling or positive plasticity and synaptic transmission.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling
rationale: Members combine Rab/ARF signalling and RabGAPs with endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling to the plasma membrane, unlike confusables about neuronal receptor trafficking, Golgi budding/tubulation or Golgi-lysosome transport.

name: Telomere C-strand synthesis and telomere end packaging
rationale: Members cover C-strand fill-in synthesis, telomere packaging, recombination inhibition and telomerase restraint, distinguishing it from confusables about telomere capping, recombination-based maintenance or telomerase extension.

qualifier: degron rules and K48 ubiquitination control
name: Degron-directed proteasomal protein degradation and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal catabolism via N- and C-end degron rules, K48 ubiquitination, deubiquitination and protein destabilization, unlike confusables about ERAD/misfolded protein quality control, atypical ubiquitin chains or ribosome-associated quality control.

qualifier: type II cotransporters and hypophosphatemic disorders
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport and hypophosphatemic disorders
rationale: All members concern type II Na+/Pi cotransporters and disorders from their loss, unlike confusables about FGF23-Klotho signalling, bone mineralization and other calcification disorders.
